limitations: TLS/gRPC server for the synthetic DNA coordinator only; no physical device, pipette, robot, sensor or scanner interface
Root inventory, withdrawals and network receipts share the existing atomic Journal; no second sample ledger
Network command acceptance, worker claims and cancellation acceptance do not prove physical transfer or resource release
No ROS runtime, LAN qualification, certified SiLA conformance, laboratory performance or hardware safety claim
Archived standard feature definitions remain unchanged; LockController v1.0 is retained
Pause points are private server test injection and are not network command parameters
